snippet.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION | Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Final Fantasy VII Revelation launches April 8, 2027 on PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, and Epic Games Store.

Everything leads here. Venture across the expanded world of FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION and join Cloud and his unique companions in their final battle against Sephiroth and the mighty Weapons.
